policies: This is a walking tour, and you'll be on your feet for most of the experience. Some stops may include stairs, as a few of our partner restaurants are located on upper levels.

If you have any allergies, dietary intolerances, or health restrictions, please let me know in advance. Our tastings often include gluten, dairy, nuts, and meat, and I want to ensure your experience is both safe and enjoyable!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Banff with all your senses on this delicious walking & breakfast nibbling tour of Canada’s most iconic mountain town.

Wake up your senses with a delicious journey through the flavours of the Rockies with Joanna... a local, Banff resident with many years of food tour experience. 

This one-of-a-kind morning tour celebrates the best of Banff with locally inspired delights—think rich smoked salmon, golden maple syrup, freshly baked goods, and more. From rustic alpine charm to gourmet Canadian tastes, this breakfast experience is as breathtaking as the mountain views.

Our tours are proudly themed around the authentic Rocky Mountain Canadian experience — fresh mountain air, hearty local bites, and laid-back exploration. We walk, we nibble, and we soak up the charm of Banff without any pretense. It’s all about real flavours, real places, and real stories — all rooted in the spirit of the Rockies.

Visit some real hidden gems, as you snack on a variety of Canadian favourites.
